page: The Amazon Web Services u7i-12tb.224xlarge is an ultra-high-memory instance belonging to the Memory Optimized family, powered by the AWS Nitro System. Built on an x86_64 Intel architecture, the host provides 896 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 448 physical cores with two threads per core running at a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz. The defining characteristic of this platform is its memory subsystem, providing 12,288 GB (12 TB) of RAM, which equates to 13.71 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware capabilities prioritize massive in-memory processing without local disk integration. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring all persistent storage access to operate through external networked block storage. Networking performance is established at a 100 Gbps baseline. There are zero bundled hardware GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the instance allocation.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the configuration targets organizations that require single-node monolithic scale. While multi-node clusters can distribute smaller workloads across lower-cost compute instances, certain in-memory systems suffer latency penalties when sharded across nodes. The u7i-12tb.224xlarge provides density for non-distributed datasets, offsetting the overhead of distributed consensus algorithms at the expense of requiring high infrastructure consolidation onto a single failure domain.

The u7i-12tb.224xlarge is engineered specifically for mission-critical enterprise workloads that cannot be partitioned, such as massive in-memory transactional and analytical databases, large SAP HANA deployments, and real-time enterprise-scale in-memory caching and analytics.
description: The Amazon Web Services u7i-12tb.224xlarge is an ultra-high-memory instance within the Memory Optimized family running on the AWS Nitro System. Featuring an x86_64 Intel processor clocked at 1.9 GHz, it supplies 896 dedicated vCPUs across 448 physical cores and provides 12,288 GB of RAM, yielding 13.71 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, routing persistent I/O over network-attached storage supported by a 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Without bundled public IPv4 addresses, it is architecturally tailored to consolidate monolithic in-memory datasets onto a single computing platform. This configuration provides the memory density necessary for extremely demanding applications, functioning as an engine for enterprise scale in-memory databases like SAP HANA, intensive real-time analytical processing, and large in-memory caching environments that cannot be distributed across multi-node topologies.
